### Advertised charges, not all-in costs
Single-branch offers billed monthly, from the **latest observation date in our database**. The table shows that date; it is not a live price feed. Initial coverage: three Dubai branches, **not the entire UAE**.

Commitments, fees, tax treatment, offer type and included facilities may differ or be unknown. **Do not interpret these bars as a like-for-like value ranking or total contract cost.** Unknown is not zero. Consult each source and the conditions table. No eligible rows means no comparison—not free membership.

panels.title: Advertised monthly charge · not total cost
panels.description: Same single-branch access category and monthly billing. Alphabetical order. Unknown-priced offers are excluded; different plans are not asserted to be equivalent.

targets.rawSql: SELECT brand_name AS "Offer", advertised_price_aed::double precision AS "Advertised charge" FROM memberships WHERE observed_on = (SELECT MAX(observed_on) FROM memberships) AND access_scope = 'single_branch' AND billing_period_months = 1 AND advertised_price_aed IS NOT NULL ORDER BY brand_name, branch_name, plan_name, id

panels.title: Terms and evidence · scroll right for source and full notes

targets.rawSql: SELECT brand_name AS "Gym", branch_name AS "Branch", plan_name AS "Plan", advertised_price_aed::double precision AS "AED/month", minimum_commitment_months AS "Commitment months", joining_fee_aed::double precision AS "Joining fee AED", COALESCE(offer_type, 'Unknown') AS "Offer type", observed_on::text AS "Observed", source_url AS "Source", notes AS "Conditions / unknowns" FROM memberships WHERE observed_on = (SELECT MAX(observed_on) FROM memberships) AND access_scope = 'single_branch' AND billing_period_months = 1 AND advertised_price_aed IS NOT NULL ORDER BY brand_name, branch_name, plan_name, id
